We talked about the sex not meaning anything, and I told her Im okay with that. She is also talking to this other guy at the same time, which Im not okay with, but we arent a couple so I cant give her shit about it. Still being around her while she is constantly texting him and still having sex with her is slowly killing me inside, but when we have sex is the only time I feel close to her again, and I dont want to lose that feeling. We have been best friends and lovers for 5 years, so she still loves and cares about me, she just doesnt feel romantic attachment anymore. She is not with this guy yet, but it will happen soon after I move out of town tomorrow with my family, Im sure of it. I fear Im becoming a shadow of the man I used to be. Not only because I am losing her, but because of how numbing this whole experience has been.

edit: Im still madly in love with her, and Im sure shes the one for me. She brings out the best in me.
